notes: Edric's letter to his sons (training level A8, D-59): a readable thing, not a key. Nothing is keyed to these words; what the brothers make of it is their own.
title: To my boys
intro: Aldo, Berin. If you're reading this, I'm under the hill, and I'll wager you're shouting.
The farm is Aldo's, who stayed and broke his back on it. The north field is Berin's, if he ever comes home; I always said so and I meant it. Share the ox. Look after your mother.
You're more alike than either of you will ever admit. Don't you dare fight over me. Your father, Edric.
